title: FORWARD pre-registration -- shadow-measure the two surviving entry gates before arming either
why_forward_and_not_now: Both candidates below produce a large in-sample dollar edge on the 25-day live-fills population, and NEITHER separates from chance on the discriminating test. The within-day permutation -- hold each day's number of blocked entries fixed, randomise WHICH entries inside that day are blocked, 20,000 draws -- returns p=0.145 (V-d1) and p=0.063 (V-e3) across 17 cells tested, uncorrected. That test asks 'did the rule pick the bad ENTRY' rather than 'did the rule sit out a bad DAY', and the honest reading is that most of the measured edge is the second thing. Arming an entry filter on that evidence is exactly how this repo's entry-filter graveyard was filled, and it cuts against J's standing correction that on paper we bias toward TAKING the trade.

candidates.provenance: PRE-REGISTERED (brief variant d), frozen b9cd7a6e before any scoring
candidates.rule: Refuse an entry when the LAST FULLY CLOSED 5m bar closed AGAINST the trade direction (close <= open for a long; close >= open for a short).

candidates.provenance: POST-HOC -- designed after reading the 2026-08-05 tape. Explicitly cannot ship on the population that produced it. This file is its first legitimate registration.
candidates.rule: Refuse an entry when crypto/lib/market_structure.analyze_structure(window=5) over the session's CLOSED 1-MINUTE RTH bars (strictly before the fill) reports NO BOS and NO CHoCH -- i.e. the tape has produced no confirmed structure at all. Abstain (never block) with fewer than 20 closed 1m bars.
candidates.why_1m_not_5m: the 5m structure read is BLIND for the first ~40 minutes: 54 of 230 live entries (23%), every entry between 09:30 and 10:06 ET, occur before 8 closed 5m bars exist. On 2026-08-05 a 5m gate abstained on the first six 776C entries. 1m reaches quorum by ~09:50.
candidates.why_PRESENCE_not_AGREEMENT: bucketing the population by the 5m structure read: AGREES n=120 +$344 (WR 18.3%); DISAGREES n=18 +$559 (WR 27.8%); NO EVENT AT ALL n=38 -$1,366 (WR 10.5%). The disagree cohort is the most profitable in the book. Absence of structure is the killer, not conflict -- so the brief's variant (a) as written gates on the wrong property.

measurement_protocol.mode: SHADOW ONLY. Neither gate may refuse a live entry during this window. Both are logged as would_block booleans alongside every entry the engine actually takes.
measurement_protocol.where: one boolean pair per ENTER decision row, alongside the existing entry ledger fields
measurement_protocol.window: the next 10 trading sessions with at least one engine fill
measurement_protocol.no_peeking_rule: no interim arming, no cell edits, no threshold tweaks inside the window. If either rule needs a change, this pre-registration is void and a new one is written.
measurement_protocol.cost: $0 -- pure Python on data the tick already has in memory.

forward_gates.F1_direction: forward delta_usd > 0 over the shadow window
forward_gates.F3_frequency: n_blocked >= 8 forward (otherwise the window is uninformative, extend rather than judge)
forward_gates.F4_discrimination: within-day permutation p <= 0.10 on the POOLED (in-sample + forward) population -- the gate that neither candidate clears today
forward_gates.F5_regime_neutral: forward delta >= 0 on both the best and the worst session in the window

verdict_ladder.EXTEND: F3 fails (too few blocks) -- run 10 more sessions, judge nothing
verdict_ladder.KILL: F1 or F2 fails, or F4 still fails on the pooled population

kill_criterion_precommitted: If, after 20 pooled sessions, F4 still fails for both candidates, BOTH go to the graveyard as 'entry filters that only ever reduced exposure on bad days' and the entry-selection lens is closed for this population. That is a real possible outcome and is being written down now, before the data exists.
what_would_falsify_the_whole_idea: If the forward blocked cohort's win rate is indistinguishable from the population win rate (18.3%), then the rules are not selecting bad entries at all and every in-sample dollar was day-level exposure reduction.
